---
title: Configuration
---

`biblint.toml` contains formatting policy, rule selection, and file discovery.
The command line chooses the operation and output format.

## Discovery

Without `--config`, biblint searches upward from the input path.
An explicitly supplied config path takes precedence.
Commit one config file at the repository root so collaborators and CI share the policy.

The top-level file-selection settings apply to both `check` and `format`:

```toml
include = ["**/*.bib"]
exclude = ["vendor/**"]
default-exclude = true
```

Directories contribute `.bib` files recursively.
Explicit file arguments are accepted regardless of extension.
With `default-exclude = true`, `.git/**` and `target/**` are skipped.

## Rule selection

```toml
[lint]
# `select` replaces the default rule set.
select = ["duplicate_key", "duplicate_doi"]

# `extend-select` adds rules without removing defaults.
extend-select = ["key_format"]

# `ignore` wins over selection.
ignore = ["unsupported_escape"]

[lint.per-file-ignores]
"generated/**" = ["formatting"]
```

Use `all` as a wildcard.
If `select` is omitted, default-enabled rules run.
`extend-select` adds opt-in rules, while `ignore` takes precedence.
Per-file ignores use the same rule names.

## Starter configuration

```toml
include = ["**/*.bib"]
exclude = ["vendor/**", "generated/**"]
default-exclude = true

[lint]
extend-select = ["duplicate_doi", "duplicate_citation", "key_format"]

[lint.key-format]
style = "better-bibtex"

[format]
indent = 2
align = false
lowercase = true
sort = ["key"]
sort-fields = ["title", "author", "year"]

[format.key-generation]
formula = "auth.lower + year + shorttitle(1,0)"
```

The formula is optional because it is biblint's default.
See [Citekey generation](key-generation.md) for the available syntax.

## Validation

Unknown settings, rule names, invalid globs, and invalid formulas are rejected when the configuration is loaded.
Settings not specified in the file use their defaults.
